greeting: Welcome to Keep Smiling Visuals. Take a look around — or I can show you the highlights.
returningGreeting: Welcome back. Want me to point you somewhere?
help: Walk with WASD or the joystick, click or tap the floor to walk there, and press E or tap Interact near anything that glows softly. The Stations menu takes you anywhere instantly.

tour.text: This is the booking desk. Planning a film? Tell us about it here — it only takes a couple of minutes.
The showreel wall. A quick taste of the KSV style, projected big.
The project TV holds the full portfolio, sorted by category and searchable.
The reading lounge. Every book here is a journal post.
The timeline shelf collects milestones and stories behind the work.
The music corner features Free Music Plug.
The gallery wall. Click a frame to see the photograph up close and request a print.
And the phone, for when you'd rather just get in touch. Enjoy the studio!
